verdict.rationale: Adyen documents merchant-side agentic checkout: AI agents such as Gemini, ChatGPT and Copilot can find products and make purchases. Merchants get ACP and UCP checkout flows plus a dedicated Google AI Mode/Gemini integration. They also get a Cart API with session commit/cancel, a product feed synced to OpenAI and Meta, and embedded commerce so shoppers complete transactions without leaving the agent. missing for 10: explicit evidence of Claude as a supported purchase surface, independent or hands-on corroboration of live in-chat purchases.
